title: cynanchum viminale subsp. orangeanum
intro: Cynanchum viminale subsp. orangeanum, commonly known as Veldt Grape or Yellow Milk Vine, is a plant species that belongs to the Apocynaceae family. It is used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include treating fever, headache, and respiratory issues, as well as lowering blood pressure and cholesterol levels. The therapeutic actions of Cynanchum viminale subsp. orangeanum are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may help to soothe the nervous system and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
